annotation.title_clean: Konsultasi Publik Buku Putih Peta Jalan Kecerdasan Artifisial Nasional dan Konsep Pedoman Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation on the White Paper on the National Artificial Intelligence Roadmap and the Draft Artificial Intelligence Ethics Guidelines
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital (Komdigi), Republic of Indonesia
named_instruments_referenced: Indonesia MoCI Circular Letter No. 9 of 2023 on AI Ethics
Indonesia National AI Roadmap White Paper
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (8 Aug 2025). It opens a public consultation, running until 22 Aug 2025, on the White Paper on the National AI Roadmap and the Draft AI Ethics Guidelines. The consultation seeks stakeholder input to shape future AI policy and regulation in Indonesia.
key_provisions_or_claims: Komdigi drafted a National AI Roadmap White Paper with a 443-member multistakeholder task force
Draft AI Ethics Guidelines build on Circular Letter No. 9/2023 on AI Ethics
White Paper is the basis for future AI policy and regulatory strategy
Public comments accepted by email until 22 August 2025
